tweets.text:
A nonprofit called "Power Forward Communities," barely a few months old and scraping by with just $100 in its account, was tied closely to Democrat Stacey Abrams when DOGE revealed it had been handed $2 billion in taxpayer money in 2024.

Stacey Abrams founded two other nonprofits listed as partners on the Power Forward Communities website. She also works as senior counsel for Rewiring America, which spearheads a coalition that counts Power Forward Communities among its members.

Free Beacon reports: “Power Forward Communities' grant was one of just eight Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund grants that the EPA doled out in April 2024 and that, altogether, totaled $20 billion. EPA administrator Lee Zeldin announced on Feb. 13 that his staff and Department of Government Efficiency officials discovered that the Biden administration parked that same $20 billion at an outside financial institution before leaving office, limiting the federal government's oversight of the program.”
